_about: The collateral tables (docs/world/collateral-run.md; WorldCollateral). budget: the casualties a rolling 60 s admits, by tier 1 to 4, as shares of the people present at the stage's start; ceiling: the cumulative total, by tier; eventAllow: what one set piece of each kind may borrow beyond the window's room, by tier. The fifth entry of each (the boss) lives in data/fight/tier5.json. meterNorm: what the per-casualty meter gains (menace, power, anguish) are divided by: pop0 (the arena's people at full: a casualty is worth the same in ruins) or present (the people there now). catastrophe: the mass-collapse set piece (Research); its allowance below tier 5 is zero.
